target_host: accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS / self-hosted Linux X64 runner clay

live_external_evidence.claim_used: The WAL-reset corruption race affects SQLite through 3.51.2 under the documented concurrent writer/checkpoint topology and is fixed in 3.51.3+.

hypothesis: The V4 fixed-SQLite guard is sufficient to establish that the admitted runtime artifact is the independently authorized production SQLite artifact.
strongest_counterhypothesis: V4 establishes strong internal consistency with a caller-supplied manifest digest, but without an independently pinned deployment/owner trust anchor the caller can select between distinct self-consistent runtime artifacts and have either admitted.

adjudication.mechanism_supported: V4 strongly validates runtime consistency against the supplied manifest digest, exact mapped library, source id, stdlib origin and isolated no-site loader policy.
adjudication.mechanism_not_supported: No independent owner/deployment trust anchor was shown that constrains which manifest digest is authorized before V4 admission.

architecture_delta.delta: Require a non-caller-selectable production trust anchor for the fixed SQLite manifest/runtime identity before V4 admission can contribute to release acceptance. The trust anchor must be bound by owner/deployment policy or an equivalently non-bypassable artifact identity mechanism and must fail closed on digest substitution, downgrade or library swap.
architecture_delta.rollback: This receipt changes no production runtime and grants no effect authority; remove/disable only the bounded research workflow if it creates maintenance noise.

next_discriminating_test.test: Bind one accepted 3.53.4 manifest digest to a non-caller-selectable deployment trust anchor, wire the exact productive Frank/UnifiedDB persistence entrypoint through that guard, then prove on accepted target that valid boot succeeds while manifest-digest substitution, alternate same-source build, downgrade and library swap all fail closed before persistence opens. Follow with exact crash/restart/WAL persistence evidence on that same admitted runtime.

non_claims: The private 3.53.4 candidate is not yet proven to be the productive Frank persistence runtime.
System Python 3.45.1 is not made safe by the private candidate.
No whole Frank v0.1 acceptance is claimed.
No final model training authorization is implied or changed.
